Getting started

New connection (Ctrl+K): choose SFTP if possible (encrypted), then the host, the user and the password. Tick “Remember” to keep the password in the Windows vault. After that, double-clicking the server in “My servers” is enough. Your FileZilla sites can be imported with Servers → Import.

Files

Your computer on the left, the server on the right. Drag files from one panel to the other to copy them. Right click: download, rename, delete, permissions, edit a text file.

Transfers

The Transfers tab shows the queue: pause, cancel, retry. Every file is checked after copying (size, and checksum when the server supports it). An existing file is never replaced without your consent.

Synchronization

Tools → Synchronize folders compares the two folders on screen and shows you the list before any copy. Mirror mode also deletes from the destination what no longer exists in the source: check the preview.

SSH terminal, scheduled tasks, assistant

An “SSH (terminal)” profile opens a console. Tools → Scheduled tasks runs uploads, downloads or synchronizations at set times, as long as SMFTP is open (or minimized to the notification area). The AI Assistant answers your questions and prepares actions; each one is confirmed with you before it is carried out.
